_note: Sonata Effects as of Version 3.7, sourced from Prydwen (prydwen.gg/wuthering-waves/echoes); Flower of Tinged Yearning (3.7) is not added yet. Icons live in /public/echoes/<id>.webp. 'Endless Resonance' keeps the legacy id lingering_tunes.

echoSets.name: Heart of Sworn Vigil
echoSets.fivePiece: Inflicting Electro Flare on the target, obtaining Unison, or triggering Unison Response increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by 15% and grants them 22.5% Electro DMG for 30s.

echoSets.name: Celestial Light
echoSets.fivePiece: Upon using Intro Skill, Spectro DMG increases by 30% for 15s.

echoSets.name: Chromatic Foam
echoSets.fivePiece: When the Resonator inflicts Fusion Burst on the enemies, they gain the following effects: Gain 10% Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s. While this effect is active, casting an Outro Skill grants the incoming Resonator 25% Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s.

echoSets.name: Empyrean Anthem
echoSets.fivePiece: Increase the Resonator's Coordinated Attack DMG by 80%. Upon a critical hit of Coordinated Attack, increase the active Resonator's ATK by 20% for 4s.

echoSets.name: Endless Resonance
echoSets.fivePiece: While on the field, ATK increases by 5% every 1.5s, stacking up to 4 times. Outro Skill DMG increases by 60%.

echoSets.name: Eternal Radiance
echoSets.fivePiece: Inflicting enemies with Spectro Frazzle increases Crit. Rate by 20% for 15s. Attacking enemies with 10 stacks of Spectro Frazzle grants 15% Spectro DMG Bonus for 15s.

echoSets.name: Flaming Clawprint
echoSets.fivePiece: Casting Resonance Liberation grants all Resonators in the team 15% Fusion DMG Bonus and the caster 20% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus, lasting for 35s.

echoSets.name: Freezing Frost
echoSets.fivePiece: Upon using Basic Attack or Heavy Attack, Glacio DMG increases by 10%, stacking up to three times, lasting for 15s.

echoSets.name: Frosty Resolve
echoSets.fivePiece: Casting Resonance Skill grants 22.5% Glacio DMG Bonus for 15s and casting Resonance Liberation increases Resonance Skill DMG by 18%, lasting for 5s. This effect stacks up to 2 times.

echoSets.name: Gusts of Welkin
echoSets.fivePiece: Inflicting Aero Erosion upon enemies increases Aero DMG for all Resonators in the team by 15%, and for the Resonator triggering this effect by an additional 15%, lasting for 20s.

echoSets.name: Halo of Starry Radiance
echoSets.fivePiece: When healing a Resonator in the team, every 1% of Off-Tune Buildup Rate grants a 0.2% ATK increase to all Resonators in the team for 4s, up to 25%. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

echoSets.name: Havoc Eclipse
echoSets.fivePiece: Upon using Basic Attack or Heavy Attack, Havoc DMG increases by 7.5%, stacking up to four times for 15s.

echoSets.name: Heart of Evil's Purge
echoSets.fivePiece: Inflicting Tune Strain - Shifting increases Crit. DMG by 20% and Aero DMG Bonus 30% for 15s.

echoSets.name: Lamp of Nether Road
echoSets.fivePiece: Upon gaining a Shield, gain 5% increase in Crit. Rate for 5s, max 4 stacks. This effect can be triggered every 0.5s. At max stacks, gain 15% Fusion DMG Bonus.

echoSets.name: Midnight Veil
echoSets.fivePiece: When Outro Skill is triggered, deal additional 480% Havoc DMG to surrounding enemies, considered Outro Skill DMG, and grant the incoming Resonator 15% Havoc DMG Bonus for 15s.

echoSets.name: Molten Rift
echoSets.fivePiece: Upon using Resonance Skill, Fusion DMG increases by 30% for 15s.

echoSets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echoSets.fivePiece: Upon using Outro Skill, ATK of the next Resonator increases by 22.5% for 15s.

echoSets.name: Pact of Neonlight Leap
echoSets.fivePiece: Casting Outro Skill increases the ATK of the incoming Resonator by 15%, with each point of Tune Break Boost additionally increasing ATK by 0.3%, up to 15%. This effect lasts for 15s, or until the Resonator is switched out.

echoSets.name: Reel of Spliced Memories
echoSets.fivePiece: Inflicting Tune Rupture - Shifting or Tune Strain - Shifting on enemies increases the Tune Break Boost of Resonators in the team by 20 for 30s. Effects of the same name do not stack.

echoSets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echoSets.fivePiece: Upon healing allies, increase ATK of the entire team by 15%, lasting 30s.

echoSets.name: Rite of Gilded Revelation
echoSets.fivePiece: Dealing Basic Attack DMG increases Spectro DMG by 10% for 5s, stacking up to 3 times. With 3 stacks, casting Resonance Liberation grants 40% Basic Attack DMG Bonus.

echoSets.name: Shadow of Shattered Dreams
echoSets.twoPiece: Inflicting Hack - Shifting on the target grants 35% Basic Attack DMG Bonus and Heavy Attack DMG Bonus for 15s.

echoSets.name: Sierra Gale
echoSets.fivePiece: Upon using Intro Skill, Aero DMG increases by 30% for 15s.

echoSets.name: Song of Feathered Trace
echoSets.fivePiece: Upon inflicting Havoc Bane, gain Xuanling's Feather, which grants a 20% increase in Crit. Rate and 35% increase in Heavy Attack DMG Bonus to the Resonator, lasting 15s.Upon inflicting Glacio Chafe, gain Chongming's Feather, which grants a 0.1% increase in ATK to Resonators in the team for every 1% of the Resonator's Energy Regen, up to 25%, lasting 10s.

echoSets.name: Sound of True Name
echoSets.fivePiece: Dealing Echo Skill DMG to enemies increases the Resonator's Echo Skill Crit. Rate by 20%, and grants 15% Aero DMG Bonus for 5s.

echoSets.name: Tidebreaking Courage
echoSets.fivePiece: Increase the Resonator's ATK by 15%. Reaching 250% Energy Regen increases all Attribute DMG by 30% for the Resonator.

echoSets.name: Trailblazing Star
echoSets.fivePiece: Inflicting Fusion Burst or Tune Rupture - Shifting increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by 20% and grants 20% Fusion DMG Bonus for 8s.

echoSets.name: Void Thunder
echoSets.fivePiece: Upon using Heavy Attack or Resonance Skill, Electro DMG increases by 15%, stacking up to 2 times, each stack lasting for 15s.

echoSets.name: Windward Pilgrimage
echoSets.fivePiece: Hitting a target with Aero Erosion increases Crit. Rate by 10% and grants 30% Aero DMG Bonus, lasting for 10s.

echoSets.name: Wishes of Quiet Snowfall
echoSets.fivePiece: Inflicting Glacio Chafe on enemies increases Glacio DMG dealt by 10% for 15s. The Resonator gains the Snowfall effect for 15s, which can be triggered once every 25s. While Snowfall is active: Dealing Resonance Liberation DMG removes Snowfall and increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by 25% for 6s. While the effect is active, dealing Resonance Liberation DMG extends its duration by 4s, triggered once every 0.5s, up to 6 times. Casting Outro Skill removes Snowfall and grants 25% Glacio DMG Bonus to the incoming Resonator for 15s. When Snowfall is removed, only one of the effects above can be triggered.
